description:
intent=i043 snapshot=s11 branch=net-epidx status=complete
finding location=drivers/net/usb/r8152.c:1352-1361 confidence=high conclusion=r8152 alloc_all_mem reads alt->endpoint + 2 .desc.bInterval (r8152.c:1355,1430) to program the interrupt-URB interval with no bNumEndpoints>=3 check anywhere in the driver; a gadget matching the Realtek/Lenovo/NVIDIA IDs with <=2 endpoints OOB-reads at ifup.
finding location=drivers/net/usb/qmi_wwan.c:291-318 confidence=medium conclusion=qmi_wwan_register_subdriver reads control-interface endpoint[0] with no bNumEndpoints check (qmi_wwan.c:304) and passes &dev->status->desc to usb_cdc_wdm_register (316); a zero-endpoint CDC control interface with a union-pointed data interface makes element 0 OOB/NULL, crashing probe on plug-in.
finding location=drivers/net/wireless/ath/ath9k/hif_usb.c:1214-1230 confidence=high conclusion=ath9k_hif_usb send_eject_command reads altsetting[0].endpoint[1] then [0] with no bNumEndpoints check (hif_usb.c:1225) directly from probe for storage ID 0cf3:20ff; a 0-1-endpoint gadget OOB-reads/crashes probe or feeds the OOB-read address into the eject bulk pipe.
finding location=drivers/net/wireless/zydas/zd1211rw/zd_usb.c:1272-1290 confidence=high conclusion=zd1211rw eject_installer reads altsetting[0].endpoint[1] then [0] with no bNumEndpoints check (zd_usb.c:1283) directly from probe for installer IDs 0ace:2011/0ace:20ff; a 0-1-endpoint gadget OOB-reads/crashes probe on plug-in.
coverage_gap=drivers/net/wwan does not exist in snapshot s11, so wwan USB NIC paths could not be searched in this tree; only drivers/net/usb and drivers/net/wireless were in scope of the actual search.
coverage_gap=cdc_mbim.c and huawei_cdc_ncm.c were spot-checked only for status-endpoint consumption (both guard on dev->status set by the bounded cdc_ncm/usbnet paths); their full control-interface handling was not read end to end.
coverage_gap=The ath9k/ath6kl/ath10k htc_endpoint arrays and the zd1211rw usb_pipe_endpoint uses (zd_usb.c:1592,1906) are internal driver structures or core-validated pipes, not USB descriptor-array indexing; this was established by struct-type grep, not full data-flow review.
